literature.headline_zh: 人肠道病毒研究新进展:神经毒力机制、受体识别与流行病学动态。
literature.lead_zh: 本周研究揭示了肠道病毒A71神经毒力的理化指纹、肠道病毒D68的双受体门控机制、柯萨奇病毒A16小鼠适应模型的建立,以及西安市手足口病病原体的流行变迁,为抗病毒策略和疫苗开发提供了新见解。
key_findings_zh: EV-A71神经毒力与5个理化位点相关,其中P2124_Z1(OR=4.28)为最强预测因子,但受限于仅7个CNS阳性样本[10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199772]。
EV-D68通过MFSD6受体和唾液酸聚糖形成“二元门控开关”机制,确保仅在正确受体结合时启动感染[10.1038/s41467-026-75856-2]。
生物碱在动物模型中显著提高EV-A71感染生存率(OR=30.62),核心靶点涉及MAPK、TNF和IL-17通路[10.3390/ijms27156571]。
小鼠适应CVA16-P5株在新生小鼠中稳定诱导神经系统疾病,VP1突变与神经毒力增强相关[10.1128/jvi.00656-26]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: CVA16 B1c亚系在西安的首次出现反映了全国性基因型变迁趋势,需加强监测;免疫功能低下患者(如接受利妥昔单抗治疗)发生肠道病毒脑炎的风险值得警惕。
literature.caveats_zh: EV-A71神经毒力研究因CNS阳性样本极少(7例),AUC和OR值应视为探索性结果,需独立队列验证。
literature.headline_en: New Advances in Human Enterovirus Research: Neurovirulence Mechanisms, Receptor Recognition, and Epidemiological Dynamics.
literature.lead_en: This week's studies reveal physicochemical fingerprints of enterovirus A71 neurovirulence, a dual-receptor gating switch for enterovirus D68, a mouse-adapted coxsackievirus A16 model, and pathogen shifts in Xi'an hand-foot-mouth disease, offering new insights for antiviral strategies and vaccine development.
key_findings_en: EV-A71 neurovirulence is associated with five physicochemical loci, with P2124_Z1 as the strongest predictor (OR=4.28), but limited by only 7 CNS-positive samples [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199772].
EV-D68 uses a 'binary gating switch' mechanism via MFSD6 receptor and sialic acid glycans, ensuring productive infection only upon correct receptor engagement [10.1038/s41467-026-75856-2].
Alkaloids significantly improve survival (OR=30.62) in EV-A71 animal models, with core targets involving MAPK, TNF, and IL-17 pathways [10.3390/ijms27156571].
Mouse-adapted CVA16-P5 strain consistently induces neurological disease in neonatal mice, with a VP1 mutation linked to enhanced neurovirulence [10.1128/jvi.00656-26].

In Xi'an (2020-2024), CVA6 (52.8%) and CVA16 (23.8%) dominate HFMD; CVA6 infection carries higher severe disease risk (OR=12.93), and CVA16 B1c sublineage emerged in 2024 [10.1097/inf.0000000000005319].
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The first detection of CVA16 B1c sublineage in Xi'an mirrors a national genotype shift, warranting enhanced surveillance; enterovirus encephalitis risk in immunocompromised patients (e.g., on rituximab) deserves attention.
literature.caveats_en: The EV-A71 neurovirulence study is limited by extremely few CNS-positive samples (n=7); AUC and OR values should be considered exploratory pending validation in independent cohorts.
literature.brief_en: This week's research on human enteroviruses uncovered physicochemical markers of EV-A71 neurovirulence, a dual-receptor gating mechanism for EV-D68 entry, a mouse-adapted CVA16 model for neuropathogenesis, and epidemiological shifts in Xi'an HFMD pathogens, highlighting the emergence of CVA16 B1c and the need for multivalent vaccines.
brief_items_zh: 本周研究揭示了肠道病毒A71神经毒力的理化指纹、肠道病毒D68的双受体门控机制、柯萨奇病毒A16小鼠适应模型的建立,以及西安市手足口病病原体的流行变迁,为抗病毒策略和疫苗开发提供了新见解。
EV-A71神经毒力与5个理化位点相关,其中P2124_Z1(OR=4.28)为最强预测因子,但受限于仅7个CNS阳性样本[10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199772]。
EV-D68通过MFSD6受体和唾液酸聚糖形成“二元门控开关”机制,确保仅在正确受体结合时启动感染[10.1038/s41467-026-75856-2]。
生物碱在动物模型中显著提高EV-A71感染生存率(OR=30.62),核心靶点涉及MAPK、TNF和IL-17通路[10.3390/ijms27156571]。
小鼠适应CVA16-P5株在新生小鼠中稳定诱导神经系统疾病,VP1突变与神经毒力增强相关[10.1128/jvi.00656-26]。
brief_items_en: This week's studies reveal physicochemical fingerprints of enterovirus A71 neurovirulence, a dual-receptor gating switch for enterovirus D68, a mouse-adapted coxsackievirus A16 model, and pathogen shifts in Xi'an hand-foot-mouth disease, offering new insights for antiviral strategies and vaccine development.
EV-A71 neurovirulence is associated with five physicochemical loci, with P2124_Z1 as the strongest predictor (OR=4.28), but limited by only 7 CNS-positive samples [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199772].
EV-D68 uses a 'binary gating switch' mechanism via MFSD6 receptor and sialic acid glycans, ensuring productive infection only upon correct receptor engagement [10.1038/s41467-026-75856-2].
Alkaloids significantly improve survival (OR=30.62) in EV-A71 animal models, with core targets involving MAPK, TNF, and IL-17 pathways [10.3390/ijms27156571].
Mouse-adapted CVA16-P5 strain consistently induces neurological disease in neonatal mice, with a VP1 mutation linked to enhanced neurovirulence [10.1128/jvi.00656-26].

news.lead_zh: 本期人肠道病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 确认夏季暴发预防简报。黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包明甲在政府新闻发布会上介绍了诺如病毒和手足口病的预防措施。 [news-f3a36c99b541ce9a]

papers.title: Physicochemical fingerprinting reveals convergent evolutionary determinants of enterovirus A71 neurovirulence through integrative machine learning and structural analysis.
papers.abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes hand, foot, and mouth disease and can trigger life-threatening neurological complications, yet the sequence-level physicochemical correlates of CNS involvement across globally circulating lineages remain incompletely defined. Here we screened 15,247 EV-A71 genomic entries spanning 1998-2024, retaining 267 full-length sequences (≥7,000 bp) with confirmed clinical outcomes (7 central nervous system [CNS]-involved, 260 non-CNS). This extreme 7:260 class imbalance, reflecting the scarcity of publicly available full-length CNS-associated EV-A71 genomes, is the principal limitation and interpretive premise of the study. Each polyprotein position was encoded by three Z-scale descriptors-hydrophobicity (Z1), molecular volume (Z2), and electrostatic polarity (Z3)-converting discrete residue identities into a continuous biophysical feature space. A two-stage statistical pipeline (Mann-Whitney U screening followed by odds-ratio ranking) distilled 20 significant loci down to five core positions: P2124_Z1, P997_Z2, P1246_Z3, P1743_Z2, and P1711_Z1 (all P<0.001). Leave-one-out cross-validated logistic regression achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC = 0.889) among eight algorithms benchmarked. Because this AUC is estimated from only seven positive samples, it should be regarded as an exploratory internal performance signal rather than definitive evidence of generalisable accuracy. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) assigned the largest model contribution to P2124_Z1 (OR = 4.28; 95% CI 1.47-12.51), while P1246_Z3 was statistically associated with lower CNS odds (OR = 0.50); these model-derived quantities do not establish causal mechanisms. Reference-strain mapping linked the five polyprotein coordinates to mature-protein residues in 3D RdRp, 3C protease, 2C helicase, and 2A, thereby providing structural context for cautious biochemical hypotheses rather than confirmed mechanisms. Phylogenetic dispersion of CNS-associated strains was compatible with convergent evolution, but this inference remains limited by the seven available CNS genomes. We therefore present the five-position physicochemical signature and nomogram as hypothesis-generating tools for prioritising candidate neurovirulence markers, requiring prospective validation in larger and more balanced independent cohorts before clinical or field deployment.

papers.title_zh: 理化指纹通过综合机器学习和结构分析揭示了肠道病毒 A71 神经毒力的趋同进化决定因素。
papers.source_body_en: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) causes hand, foot, and mouth disease and can trigger life-threatening neurological complications, yet the sequence-level physicochemical correlates of CNS involvement across globally circulating lineages remain incompletely defined. Here we screened 15,247 EV-A71 genomic entries spanning 1998-2024, retaining 267 full-length sequences (≥7,000 bp) with confirmed clinical outcomes (7 central nervous system [CNS]-involved, 260 non-CNS). This extreme 7:260 class imbalance, reflecting the scarcity of publicly available full-length CNS-associated EV-A71 genomes, is the principal limitation and interpretive premise of the study. Each polyprotein position was encoded by three Z-scale descriptors-hydrophobicity (Z1), molecular volume (Z2), and electrostatic polarity (Z3)-converting discrete residue identities into a continuous biophysical feature space. A two-stage statistical pipeline (Mann-Whitney U screening followed by odds-ratio ranking) distilled 20 significant loci down to five core positions: P2124_Z1, P997_Z2, P1246_Z3, P1743_Z2, and P1711_Z1 (all P<0.001). Leave-one-out cross-validated logistic regression achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC = 0.889) among eight algorithms benchmarked. Because this AUC is estimated from only seven positive samples, it should be regarded as an exploratory internal performance signal rather than definitive evidence of generalisable accuracy. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) assigned the largest model contribution to P2124_Z1 (OR = 4.28; 95% CI 1.47-12.51), while P1246_Z3 was statistically associated with lower CNS odds (OR = 0.50); these model-derived quantities do not establish causal mechanisms. Reference-strain mapping linked the five polyprotein coordinates to mature-protein residues in 3D RdRp, 3C protease, 2C helicase, and 2A, thereby providing structural context for cautious biochemical hypotheses rather than confirmed mechanisms. Phylogenetic dispersion of CNS-associated strains was compatible with convergent evolution, but this inference remains limited by the seven available CNS genomes. We therefore present the five-position physicochemical signature and nomogram as hypothesis-generating tools for prioritising candidate neurovirulence markers, requiring prospective validation in larger and more balanced independent cohorts before clinical or field deployment.

papers.title: Efficacy and Mechanisms of Alkaloids Against Enterovirus A71: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Preclinical Evidence Integrated with Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking
papers.abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) is a major causative agent of hand, foot, and mouth disease, yet no specific antiviral therapy has been approved. This study systematically evaluated the efficacy and mechanisms of alkaloids against EV-A71 infection by integrating meta-analysis, network pharmacology, and molecular docking. Nine animal studies were included. Meta-analysis suggested that alkaloid intervention significantly improved survival (OR = 30.62, 95% CI: 10.44–89.82), reduced clinical severity, attenuated body weight loss, and decreased viral loads in infected tissues. Subgroup analyses preliminarily suggested that quinolizidine alkaloids and high-dose regimens (>5 mg/kg) may be associated with preclinical intervention effects. Network pharmacology predicted 155 shared targets between seven active alkaloids and EV-A71-related genes, with MAPK1, MAPK3, JUN, AURKB, and MAPK8 recognized as core targets through computational screening. Functional enrichment analysis suggested significant involvement of the MAPK, TNF, and IL-17 signaling pathways. Molecular docking provided computational support for stable binding affinities between active alkaloids and core targets (−6.7 to −9.3 kcal/mol). Collectively, these findings suggest that alkaloids exert anti-EV-A71 effects through both direct antiviral activity and host-directed regulatory mechanisms, supporting their potential as candidates for the development of novel anti-EV-A71 therapeutics.

papers.title: A dual-receptor checkpoint primes enterovirus D68 for respiratory cell entry
papers.abstract: MFSD6 is a newly identified receptor that mediates the invasion of respiratory cells by enterovirus D68 (EV-D68), a non-polio enterovirus that causes severe respiratory disease and poliomyelitis-like illness in children. Here, we report near-atomic-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of historical and contemporary AFM-associated EV-D68 strains, together with their complexes bound to the third extracellular loop of MFSD6 (MFSD6-L3). These structures uncover a previously unrecognized “binary gating switch” mechanism of virus-receptor engagement that differs from the reported model. In this mechanism, the N200-V208 segment of MFSD6, carrying a glycosylated Asn207, inserts into one capsomer, whereas the sialyl-Gal-terminated glycan of MFSD6 engages an adjacent capsomer. Neu5Ac binding induces conformational rearrangements that expel the pocket factor, destabilize the virion, and prime infection. Functional analyses further define the contributions of the receptor-contacting residues and glycans to viral attachment and entry. Together, our findings refine the molecular basis of EV-D68 recognition of MFSD6 and reveal a glycan-mediated dual-lock mechanism that may enhance receptor specificity, prevent premature uncoating, and ensure productive infection only upon engagement of the correct host receptor. These results provide broader insight into enterovirus tropism and establish a framework for structure-guided antiviral design. show how enterovirus D68 uses the respiratory receptor MFSD6 and sugar modifications to enter cells, revealing a checkpoint that primes the virus for infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to identify the molecular mechanism by which enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) invades respiratory cells, focusing on the newly identified receptor MFSD6 and its role in viral entry.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed near-atomic-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to analyze historical and contemporary AFM-associated EV-D68 strains and their complexes with the third extracellular loop of MFSD6 (MFSD6-L3).
analysis.methods: Structural analyses were conducted to determine the virus-receptor engagement mechanism, followed by functional analyses to define the contributions of receptor-contacting residues and glycans to viral attachment and entry.
analysis.main_results: The study revealed a previously unrecognized 'binary gating switch' mechanism where the N200-V208 segment of MFSD6 inserts into one capsomer, while its sialyl-Gal-terminated glycan engages an adjacent capsomer, with Neu5Ac binding inducing conformational rearrangements that prime infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as refining the molecular basis of EV-D68 recognition of MFSD6 and revealing a glycan-mediated dual-lock mechanism that enhances receptor specificity and ensures productive infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide broader insight into enterovirus tropism and establish a framework for structure-guided antiviral design, potentially informing strategies to prevent EV-D68 infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is high due to the use of near-atomic-resolution cryo-EM and functional analyses, though limitations may include the specificity of the findings to EV-D68 and potential generalizability to other enteroviruses.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) uses the respiratory receptor MFSD6 to enter cells, revealing a novel 'binary gating switch' mechanism. Through near-atomic-resolution cryo-electron microscopy, the researchers discovered that EV-D68 engages MFSD6 via two distinct interactions: a protein segment insertion and glycan binding. This dual-receptor checkpoint mechanism primes the virus for infection by inducing conformational changes that destabilize the virion. The findings enhance our understanding of enterovirus tropism and provide a foundation for developing targeted antiviral therapies against EV-D68, a virus causing severe respiratory disease and poliomyelitis-like illness in children.

papers.title_zh: 双受体检查点启动肠道病毒 D68 进入呼吸道细胞
papers.source_body_en: MFSD6 is a newly identified receptor that mediates the invasion of respiratory cells by enterovirus D68 (EV-D68), a non-polio enterovirus that causes severe respiratory disease and poliomyelitis-like illness in children. Here, we report near-atomic-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures of historical and contemporary AFM-associated EV-D68 strains, together with their complexes bound to the third extracellular loop of MFSD6 (MFSD6-L3). These structures uncover a previously unrecognized “binary gating switch” mechanism of virus-receptor engagement that differs from the reported model. In this mechanism, the N200-V208 segment of MFSD6, carrying a glycosylated Asn207, inserts into one capsomer, whereas the sialyl-Gal-terminated glycan of MFSD6 engages an adjacent capsomer. Neu5Ac binding induces conformational rearrangements that expel the pocket factor, destabilize the virion, and prime infection. Functional analyses further define the contributions of the receptor-contacting residues and glycans to viral attachment and entry. Together, our findings refine the molecular basis of EV-D68 recognition of MFSD6 and reveal a glycan-mediated dual-lock mechanism that may enhance receptor specificity, prevent premature uncoating, and ensure productive infection only upon engagement of the correct host receptor. These results provide broader insight into enterovirus tropism and establish a framework for structure-guided antiviral design. show how enterovirus D68 uses the respiratory receptor MFSD6 and sugar modifications to enter cells, revealing a checkpoint that primes the virus for infection.
papers.abstract_zh: MFSD6 是一种新发现的受体,可介导肠道病毒 D68 (EV-D68) 对呼吸道细胞的侵袭,这是一种非脊髓灰质炎肠道病毒,可导致儿童严重呼吸道疾病和脊髓灰质炎样疾病。在这里,我们报告了历史和当代 AFM 相关 EV-D68 菌株的近原子分辨率冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 结构,以及它们与 MFSD6 第三个细胞外环 (MFSD6-L3) 结合的复合物。这些结构揭示了一种以前未被识别的病毒-受体结合的“二元门控开关”机制,该机制与报道的模型不同。在此机制中,携带糖基化 Asn207 的 MFSD6 的 N200-V208 片段插入一个壳粒,而 MFSD6 的唾液酸-Gal 封端的聚糖则与相邻的壳粒接合。Neu5Ac 结合会诱导构象重排,从而排出袋因子、破坏病毒粒子的稳定性并引发感染。功能分析进一步确定了受体接触残基和聚糖对病毒附着和进入的贡献。总之,我们的研究结果完善了 EV-D68 识别 MFSD6 的分子基础,并揭示了聚糖介导的双锁机制,该机制可以增强受体特异性,防止过早脱壳,并确保只有在与正确的 宿主 受体结合时才能进行有效感染。这些结果提供了对肠道病毒向性的更广泛的了解,并为结构引导的 抗病毒药物 设计建立了框架。展示肠道病毒 D68 如何利用呼吸受体 MFSD6 和糖修饰进入细胞,揭示一个为病毒感染做好准备的检查点。

papers.title: Neurotropism and interferon-dominated immune responses in a mouse-adapted coxsackievirus A16 infection model
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The development of animal models infected with Coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16) is limited by insufficient neurovirulence, which hinders the study of pathogenesis mechanisms and antiviral drug evaluation. Therefore, we aimed to develop a neonatal ICR mouse model for CVA16 infection, wherein infected brain tissue was continuously passaged from 2-day-old ICR suckling mice, resulting in a highly neurovirulent mouse-adapted strain (CVA16-P5) to establish optimal infection conditions for antiviral assessment. By systematically optimizing viral dose, inoculation route, and age at infection, we defined conditions that reproducibly induced progressive neurological disease and multisystem involvement. Infection with the CVA16-P5 strain resulted in consistent pathological alterations across multiple tissues, accompanied by characteristic neurological manifestations. Transcriptomic analysis of neural tissues revealed tissue-specific interferon-dominated immune responses and signatures of systemic viral dissemination that recapitulate key features of severe human infection. Whole-genome sequencing identified a nonsynonymous mutation in the VP1 capsid protein associated with enhanced neurovirulence during mouse adaptation. Overall, this CVA16-P5-adapted strain infection model provides a robust experimental platform for investigating CVA16 pathogenesis and for the preclinical evaluation of vaccines and antiviral drugs against neurotropic enteroviruses. IMPORTANCE The lack of animal models that reliably recapitulate the neurological manifestations of Coxsackievirus A16 infection has constrained progress in understanding CVA16 neuropathogenesis. Here, we describe a neonatal mouse model based on a mouse-adapted CVA16 strain (CVA16-P5) that consistently induces neurological disease and multisystem pathology. This model enables the analysis of tissue-specific immune responses, viral dissemination, and genetic determinants of neurovirulence, including a VP1 mutation associated with enhanced pathogenicity. By providing a reproducible and physiologically relevant system for studying severe CVA16 infection, the CVA16-P5-adapted strain infection model setup in this study supports mechanistic studies of CVA16 pathogenesis and facilitates the preclinical evaluation of vaccines and antiviral drugs against neurotropic enteroviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 柯萨奇病毒A16(CVA16)感染动物模型的建立因神经毒力不足而受到限制,这阻碍了发病机制机制的研究和抗病毒药物药物评价。由于缺乏能够可靠地重现柯萨奇病毒 A16 感染的神经学表现的动物模型,限制了对 CVA16 神经发病机制的理解进展。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们的目的是开发 CVA16 感染的新生 ICR 小鼠模型,其中受感染的脑组织从 2 日龄的 ICR 乳鼠中连续传代,产生高神经毒力的小鼠适应株 (CVA16-P5),为 抗病毒药物 评估建立最佳感染条件。通过系统地优化病毒剂量、接种途径和感染年龄,我们定义了可重复诱导进行性神经系统疾病和多系统受累的条件。

papers.title_zh: 小鼠适应柯萨奇病毒 A16 感染模型中的神经趋向性和干扰素主导的 免疫应答
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The development of animal models infected with Coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16) is limited by insufficient neurovirulence, which hinders the study of pathogenesis mechanisms and antiviral drug evaluation. Therefore, we aimed to develop a neonatal ICR mouse model for CVA16 infection, wherein infected brain tissue was continuously passaged from 2-day-old ICR suckling mice, resulting in a highly neurovirulent mouse-adapted strain (CVA16-P5) to establish optimal infection conditions for antiviral assessment. By systematically optimizing viral dose, inoculation route, and age at infection, we defined conditions that reproducibly induced progressive neurological disease and multisystem involvement. Infection with the CVA16-P5 strain resulted in consistent pathological alterations across multiple tissues, accompanied by characteristic neurological manifestations. Transcriptomic analysis of neural tissues revealed tissue-specific interferon-dominated immune responses and signatures of systemic viral dissemination that recapitulate key features of severe human infection. Whole-genome sequencing identified a nonsynonymous mutation in the VP1 capsid protein associated with enhanced neurovirulence during mouse adaptation. Overall, this CVA16-P5-adapted strain infection model provides a robust experimental platform for investigating CVA16 pathogenesis and for the preclinical evaluation of vaccines and antiviral drugs against neurotropic enteroviruses. IMPORTANCE The lack of animal models that reliably recapitulate the neurological manifestations of Coxsackievirus A16 infection has constrained progress in understanding CVA16 neuropathogenesis. Here, we describe a neonatal mouse model based on a mouse-adapted CVA16 strain (CVA16-P5) that consistently induces neurological disease and multisystem pathology. This model enables the analysis of tissue-specific immune responses, viral dissemination, and genetic determinants of neurovirulence, including a VP1 mutation associated with enhanced pathogenicity. By providing a reproducible and physiologically relevant system for studying severe CVA16 infection, the CVA16-P5-adapted strain infection model setup in this study supports mechanistic studies of CVA16 pathogenesis and facilitates the preclinical evaluation of vaccines and antiviral drugs against neurotropic enteroviruses.

papers.title: Pathogenic Surveillance and Genetic Characteristics of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Pathogens in Xi'an, 2020-2024.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is a common pediatric infectious disease that frequently causes outbreaks in the Asia-Pacific region. The causative pathogens of HFMD are dynamically changing, with a notable genotypic shift observed in coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16) across China. METHODS: Epidemiologic data and clinical specimens were collected from reported HFMD cases. Pan-enterovirus, enterovirus A71 (EV-A71), CVA16, coxsackievirus A6 (CVA6), and coxsackievirus A10 (CVA10) were detected by real-time polymerase chain reaction. VP1 regions of CVA6 and CVA16 were amplified, sequenced, and phylogenetically analyzed. RESULTS: Among 2596 specimens, 2148 (82.7%) were enterovirus-positive. The proportions were: CVA6 52.8%, CVA16 23.8%, CVA10 5.0%, EV-A71 0.3%. CVA6 predominated in 2020, 2022 and 2023; CVA16 predominated in 2021 and 2024. Compared with CVA16 infection, CVA6 infection was associated with younger age (3.25 vs. 4.14 years, P < 0.001) and a higher risk of severe disease (OR = 12.93). All CVA6 strains detected in Xi'an were assigned to subgenotype D3a, whereas CVA16 strains were classified as B1a, B1b or B1c, among which B1a was the most prevalent (87.3%). Notably, the B1c lineage, first detected in Xi'an in 2024, accounted for a substantial proportion of cases. CONCLUSIONS: CVA6 and CVA16 are the predominant HFMD pathogens in Xi'an with alternating circulation. All identified CVA6 strains belonged to the D3a subtype, whereas the B1a subtype predominated among CVA16 strains. The first emergence of the CVA16 B1c sublineage in 2024 mirrors national trends and warrants intensified surveillance. The lack of cross-protection among serotypes highlights the need for multivalent vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the pathogenic surveillance and genetic characteristics of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) pathogens in Xi'an from 2020 to 2024. It identifies that coxsackievirus A6 (CVA6) and coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16) are the predominant pathogens, with alternating circulation over the study period. CVA6 was associated with younger age and a higher risk of severe disease. All CVA6 strains were classified as subgenotype D3a, while CVA16 strains were categorized into B1a, B1b, and B1c subtypes, with B1a being the most prevalent. The emergence of the B1c lineage in 2024 is noted as a significant trend. The study highlights the need for intensified surveillance and the potential for multivalent vaccines due to the lack of cross-protection among serotypes. However, the findings are based on observational data and may not fully account for all circulating strains, limiting the strength of the evidence.

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Follicular lymphoma (FL) is a common subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) associated with the t(14;18) translocation. First-line treatment is generally based on anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody-containing immunochemotherapy, and rituximab maintenance may be used in patients who respond to induction therapy. Although maintenance therapy prolongs progression-free survival, it may increase the risk of infection by depleting B cells and impairing humoral immunity. Enteroviral infections are usually mild or self-limited in immunocompetent individuals but can cause severe complications, including chronic encephalitis, in immunocompromised patients, particularly those receiving B-cell-depleting therapies. Case presentation We report the case of a woman diagnosed at 29 years of age with stage IV, grade 3A follicular lymphoma who developed chronic enteroviral encephalitis during rituximab maintenance therapy. After six cycles of R-CHOP, she achieved complete remission and was started on rituximab maintenance every three months. Shortly after the sixth maintenance dose, she presented with confusion and involuntary movements. Diagnostic evaluation, including cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR, confirmed enterovirus infection. Conclusion Chronic enteroviral encephalitis is a rare but serious complication in immunocompromised patients, particularly those receiving rituximab or other anti-CD20 therapies that deplete B cells and impair humoral immunity. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report a rare case of chronic enteroviral encephalitis developing in a patient undergoing rituximab maintenance therapy for follicular lymphoma, highlighting the risk of severe enteroviral complications in immunocompromised patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with stage IV, grade 3A follicular lymphoma who developed chronic enteroviral encephalitis during rituximab maintenance therapy after achieving complete remission with R-CHOP.
analysis.methods: Diagnostic evaluation included cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR to confirm enterovirus infection.
analysis.main_results: The patient presented with confusion and involuntary movements shortly after the sixth rituximab maintenance dose, and cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR confirmed enterovirus infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret chronic enteroviral encephalitis as a rare but serious complication in immunocompromised patients, particularly those receiving B-cell-depleting therapies like rituximab.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings emphasize the need for heightened awareness and monitoring of enteroviral infections in patients on anti-CD20 therapies to prevent severe neurological complications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is limited by the case report design, which lacks a control group and cannot establish causality, though the diagnostic confirmation provides moderate confidence in the reported association.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with stage IV, grade 3A follicular lymphoma who developed chronic enteroviral encephalitis during rituximab maintenance therapy. After achieving complete remission with six cycles of R-CHOP, she received rituximab every three months and presented with confusion and involuntary movements after the sixth dose. Cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR confirmed enterovirus infection. The authors highlight that chronic enteroviral encephalitis is a rare but serious complication in immunocompromised patients, particularly those receiving B-cell-depleting therapies. The findings underscore the importance of monitoring for enteroviral infections in such patients to prevent severe neurological outcomes.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 病例报告 描述了一名患有 IV 期 3A 级滤泡性淋巴瘤的 29 岁女性,在 R-CHOP 获得完全缓解后,在利妥昔单抗维持治疗期间出现慢性肠道病毒脑炎。
elements_zh.methods: 诊断评估包括脑脊液 RT-PCR 以确定肠道病毒感染。
elements_zh.main_results: 第六次利妥昔单抗维持剂量后不久,患者出现意识不清和不自主运动,脑脊液 RT-PCR 证实肠道病毒感染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将慢性肠道病毒性脑炎解释为免疫功能低下患者的一种罕见但严重的并发症,特别是那些接受利妥昔单抗等 B 细胞耗竭疗法的患者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要提高接受抗 CD20 治疗的患者肠道病毒感染的认识和监测,以预防严重的神经系统并发症。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度受到 病例报告 设计的限制,该设计缺乏对照组,无法确定因果关系,尽管诊断确认对所报告的关联提供了中等可信度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report a rare case of chronic enteroviral encephalitis developing in a patient undergoing rituximab maintenance therapy for follicular lymphoma, highlighting the risk of severe enteroviral complications in immunocompromised patients.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with stage IV, grade 3A follicular lymphoma who developed chronic enteroviral encephalitis during rituximab maintenance therapy after achieving complete remission with R-CHOP.
analysis_en.methods: Diagnostic evaluation included cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR to confirm enterovirus infection.
analysis_en.main_results: The patient presented with confusion and involuntary movements shortly after the sixth rituximab maintenance dose, and cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR confirmed enterovirus infection.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret chronic enteroviral encephalitis as a rare but serious complication in immunocompromised patients, particularly those receiving B-cell-depleting therapies like rituximab.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Findings emphasize the need for heightened awareness and monitoring of enteroviral infections in patients on anti-CD20 therapies to prevent severe neurological complications.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is limited by the case report design, which lacks a control group and cannot establish causality, though the diagnostic confirmation provides moderate confidence in the reported association.

发布会现场。纪勇摄 人民网哈尔滨7月23日电 (记者苏靖刚)7月23日,黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室举行“夏季重点传染病预防与公共卫生安全科普”新闻发布会。会上,省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家针对今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病防控形势进行了讲解,并作健康提醒。 黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家。纪勇摄 进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。包名家介绍,诺如病毒在外环境存活时间较长,不同年龄段的人群都普遍易感,多通过被病毒污染的食物、手、公共物品传播,学校、聚餐场所,特别是旅行团极易发生聚集性病例。手足口病在黑龙江省夏季为高发季节,5岁以下幼儿为高发人群,但多数为轻症,规范居家护理可痊愈。 为守护好儿童暑期身心健康,包名家提出四点核心健康提醒。要做好手卫生。开展朋友们督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。 免责声明:本内容来自腾讯平台创作者,不代表腾讯新闻或腾讯网的观点和立场。举报 相关推荐男人年过81岁,身上九大长寿特征,安稳多活十年思维精进每一天1评论前天一个男人过得好不好,看他体重就知道了,别不信然哥心理昨天人过76岁,不管儿女多孝顺,务必死守这7句话,越活越长寿扒扒动漫3评论前天免疫系统为何会攻击自己? analysis.time: Published on 2026-07-23. Event occurred on 2026-07-23 during a summer-focused press conference.
analysis.location_and_population: Heilongjiang Province, China. Affected populations include children under 5 years old (high-risk for hand-foot-mouth disease) and general populations (susceptible to norovirus).
analysis.event: Confirmed summer outbreak prevention briefing. Heilongjiang Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention director Bao Mingjia explained prevention measures for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease during a government press conference.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: No specific case counts reported. Norovirus noted for high transmissibility in schools, group dining, and travel groups. Hand-foot-mouth disease described as high incidence in summer but mostly mild in young children. Risk emphasized for vulnerable groups.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Official prevention guidelines issued. Recommendations include hand hygiene, food/water safety, isolation protocols for infected individuals, vaccination advice (EV-A71 vaccine for hand-foot-mouth disease), and respiratory disease prevention. Source limitation: Full original article body was reviewed.

analysis.brief_en: On July 23, 2026, Heilongjiang Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention director Bao Mingjia held a press conference detailing prevention measures for summer norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease outbreaks. Norovirus, which survives long in the environment, spreads easily through contaminated food, hands, and objects, particularly in schools, group dining settings, and travel groups. Hand-foot-mouth disease peaks in summer, mainly affecting children under 5, though most cases are mild. Authorities emphasized hand hygiene, safe food practices, isolation of infected individuals, and EV-A71 vaccination to reduce severe cases. The conference also highlighted respiratory disease prevention through ventilation and mask use in crowded places.

news.content: 新闻发布丨黑龙江省疾控中心专家解读夏季传染病防控与食品安全要点 23日,黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室举行新闻发布会。针对群众关注的夏季公共卫生热点问题,黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家接受记者提问,介绍了全省今夏诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病防控形势,面向广大家长发布健康防护提醒;同时围绕高温天气食品易变质风险,讲解居家、外出就餐注意事项,科普食物中毒预防相关知识。 包名家介绍,进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。诺如病毒在外环境存活时间较长,不同年龄段的人群都普遍易感,多通过被病毒污染的食物、手、公共物品传播,学校、聚餐场所,特别是旅行团极易发生聚集性病例。手足口病在我省夏季为高发季节,5岁以下幼儿为高发人群,但多数为轻症,规范居家护理可痊愈。 为守护好儿童暑期身心健康,包名家提出四点核心健康提醒。一是要做好手卫生。家长应督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 二是要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 三是要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 四是要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所有要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。包名家表示,整体来看,我省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病的防控形势总体平稳,全省疾控部门将持续做好疫情监测,落实好各项防护措施。 除此之外,夏季食品容易变质,包名家分享了外出就餐和居家饮食及预防食物中毒健康知识。他介绍,时值盛夏,气温高、湿度大,为细菌、病毒等病原体的繁殖提供了有利条件,这段时间是食物中毒、食源性疾病的高发时段。为有效避免发生食物中毒,公众要注意以下几点。 一是要做好手卫生。要养成饭前便后、加工食物前后都洗手的好习惯,洗手的时候要用肥皂水或者洗手液,在流动的水下洗手,冲洗干净。就餐时倡导使用公勺公筷。 二是要保证食材新鲜,不要食用野味、不明野生食材、过期变质食品。要到正规商超、农贸市场选购食材,购物时要仔细核对食品生产日期、保质期,避免食用过期或者腐败的食品;夏季食材要按需少量采购,避免大量囤积导致食物变质。坚决不采摘、不购买、不食用野生蘑菇、野菜,规避未知毒素风险。 三是食品要彻底煮熟煮透,尤其是肉类、海产品以及蛋类;尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净;饭菜要尽量当日吃完,剩余饭菜要及时冷藏储存,再次食用前要彻底加热;日常严格做到生熟分开,处理生食、熟食的刀具、砧板、容器要做到生熟分开,用后要清洗干净,避免交叉污染。 四是外出就餐时要选择证照齐全、环境整洁、食品安全评级良好的正规餐饮门店,坚决避开无资质流动摊贩、无证小店,从源头降低发生食物中毒风险。一旦发生食物中毒的症状,首先应立即停止食用中毒食物,尽快去就近医院进行救治。同时要注意保留可疑食品以及病人呕吐物,保护好现场,并及时向当地向监管部门报告,协助做好食物中毒的调查处理工作。 (来源:冰城新闻客户端) - 不断开创基础教育高质量发展新局面2026-07-24 - 总书记为新时代新征程基础教育工作指明方向2026-07-24 - “义乌发展经验”的深刻启示2026-07-24 - 注意防范!未来三天冰城阵雨雷阵雨轮番上线2026-07-24 - 24-28日全市多降雨 强对流天气多发 需加强防范次生灾害2026-07-24 - 冰城新闻 - 微信公众号 - 新浪微博

news.content_original: 新闻发布丨黑龙江省疾控中心专家解读夏季传染病防控与食品安全要点 23日,黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室举行新闻发布会。针对群众关注的夏季公共卫生热点问题,黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家接受记者提问,介绍了全省今夏诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病防控形势,面向广大家长发布健康防护提醒;同时围绕高温天气食品易变质风险,讲解居家、外出就餐注意事项,科普食物中毒预防相关知识。 包名家介绍,进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。诺如病毒在外环境存活时间较长,不同年龄段的人群都普遍易感,多通过被病毒污染的食物、手、公共物品传播,学校、聚餐场所,特别是旅行团极易发生聚集性病例。手足口病在我省夏季为高发季节,5岁以下幼儿为高发人群,但多数为轻症,规范居家护理可痊愈。 为守护好儿童暑期身心健康,包名家提出四点核心健康提醒。一是要做好手卫生。家长应督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 二是要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 三是要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 四是要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所有要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。包名家表示,整体来看,我省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病的防控形势总体平稳,全省疾控部门将持续做好疫情监测,落实好各项防护措施。 除此之外,夏季食品容易变质,包名家分享了外出就餐和居家饮食及预防食物中毒健康知识。他介绍,时值盛夏,气温高、湿度大,为细菌、病毒等病原体的繁殖提供了有利条件,这段时间是食物中毒、食源性疾病的高发时段。为有效避免发生食物中毒,公众要注意以下几点。 一是要做好手卫生。要养成饭前便后、加工食物前后都洗手的好习惯,洗手的时候要用肥皂水或者洗手液,在流动的水下洗手,冲洗干净。就餐时倡导使用公勺公筷。 二是要保证食材新鲜,不要食用野味、不明野生食材、过期变质食品。要到正规商超、农贸市场选购食材,购物时要仔细核对食品生产日期、保质期,避免食用过期或者腐败的食品;夏季食材要按需少量采购,避免大量囤积导致食物变质。坚决不采摘、不购买、不食用野生蘑菇、野菜,规避未知毒素风险。 三是食品要彻底煮熟煮透,尤其是肉类、海产品以及蛋类;尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净;饭菜要尽量当日吃完,剩余饭菜要及时冷藏储存,再次食用前要彻底加热;日常严格做到生熟分开,处理生食、熟食的刀具、砧板、容器要做到生熟分开,用后要清洗干净,避免交叉污染。 四是外出就餐时要选择证照齐全、环境整洁、食品安全评级良好的正规餐饮门店,坚决避开无资质流动摊贩、无证小店,从源头降低发生食物中毒风险。一旦发生食物中毒的症状,首先应立即停止食用中毒食物,尽快去就近医院进行救治。同时要注意保留可疑食品以及病人呕吐物,保护好现场,并及时向当地向监管部门报告,协助做好食物中毒的调查处理工作。 (来源:冰城新闻客户端) - 不断开创基础教育高质量发展新局面2026-07-24 - 总书记为新时代新征程基础教育工作指明方向2026-07-24 - “义乌发展经验”的深刻启示2026-07-24 - 注意防范!未来三天冰城阵雨雷阵雨轮番上线2026-07-24 - 24-28日全市多降雨 强对流天气多发 需加强防范次生灾害2026-07-24 - 冰城新闻 - 微信公众号 - 新浪微博

analysis.time: Published on 2026-07-23. The event occurred during the summer season, with no specific event date provided.
analysis.location_and_population: Heilongjiang Province, China. The affected population includes children under 5 years old (high-risk for hand-foot-mouth disease) and the general public at risk of norovirus and foodborne illnesses.
analysis.event: A press conference held by the Heilongjiang Provincial Government Information Office, where Director Bao Mingjia from the Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention provided guidance on summer infectious disease prevention and food safety. The event focused on norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) prevention, with specific emphasis on EV-A71 vaccination for HFMD.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: No specific case numbers or outbreaks were reported. The overall situation for key infectious diseases (norovirus, HFMD) is described as 'generally stable' with ongoing monitoring. Risks include transmission in schools, group dining settings, and travel groups for norovirus, and severe HFMD complications in young children if not properly managed.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The CDC is actively monitoring the epidemic situation and implementing preventive measures. Public health recommendations include hand hygiene, food safety practices, vaccination (EV-A71 vaccine), and seeking medical attention for severe symptoms. The source is an official press conference, providing authoritative guidance with no unresolved information noted.

analysis.brief_en: On July 23, 2026, the Heilongjiang Provincial Government Information Office held a press conference where Director Bao Mingjia from the Provincial CDC addressed summer infectious disease prevention and food safety. The event focused on norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD), highlighting that summer's high temperatures and humidity facilitate their spread. Norovirus affects all age groups and can cause outbreaks in schools and group settings, while HFMD primarily impacts children under 5, though most cases are mild. The CDC emphasized preventive measures including hand hygiene, food safety, EV-A71 vaccination to reduce severe HFMD risk, and avoiding crowded places when ill. The overall epidemic situation is described as stable, with ongoing monitoring and implementation of protective measures by health authorities.

news.content_zh: 2026年7月23日,黑龙江省政府新闻办公室召开新闻发布会,省疾控中心鲍明嘉主任介绍夏季传染病防治和食品安全情况。此次活动重点关注诺如病毒和手足口病(HFMD),强调夏季高温高湿有利于其传播。诺如病毒影响所有年龄段,并可在学校和团体环境中导致 暴发,而手足口病主要影响 5 岁以下儿童,尽管大多数病例较轻。CDC 强调了预防措施,包括手卫生、食品安全、EV-A71 疫苗接种,以降低严重的手足口病风险,以及生病时避免去拥挤的地方。总体疫情形势稳定,卫生部门持续监测并落实防护措施。

analysis.time: Publication date: 2026-07-23. Event date: Not explicitly stated, but the press conference was held on this date.
analysis.location_and_population: Country: China, Region: Heilongjiang Province. Affected population: General public, with emphasis on parents and children under 5 years old.
analysis.event: Confirmed press conference by Heilongjiang Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Director Bao Mingjia. The event reported a stable prevention and control situation for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) during the summer season.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Cases: Not specified. Deaths: Not mentioned. Exposures: Not specified. Spread: Norovirus can spread through contaminated food, hands, and public items, with outbreaks common in schools, dining venues, and travel groups. HFMD is highly prevalent in summer, mainly affecting children under 5, but most cases are mild. Risk: Stated as generally stable with ongoing monitoring.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Investigation: Ongoing monitoring by provincial CDC. Testing: Not explicitly mentioned. Isolation: Norovirus-infected individuals are required to stay at home and avoid group activities. Contact tracing: Not specified. Prevention: Four key reminders provided, including hand hygiene, food/water safety, monitoring for severe symptoms, and respiratory disease prevention. Treatment: Mild HFMD can be managed at home; severe cases require immediate medical attention. Vaccination: Recommended for EV-A71 to reduce severe HFMD risk. Uncertainty: No specific case numbers or outbreak details provided.

analysis.brief_en: On July 23, 2026, Heilongjiang Province's CDC Director Bao Mingjia held a press conference, confirming a stable prevention and control situation for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) during the summer. Norovirus, which spreads easily through contaminated food and surfaces, poses a risk in crowded settings like schools and travel groups. HFMD primarily affects children under 5, though most cases are mild. The CDC emphasized four key preventive measures: rigorous hand hygiene, safe food and water practices, monitoring for severe symptoms such as persistent fever, and vaccination against EV-A71 to reduce HFMD severity. Authorities continue to monitor the situation closely, with no major outbreaks reported.

news.title_zh: 新闻发布丨诺如病毒、手足口病防控形势平稳,专家给出四点提醒 - QQ News
news.source_body_en: On July 23, 2026, Heilongjiang Province's CDC Director Bao Mingjia held a press conference, confirming a stable prevention and control situation for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) during the summer. Norovirus, which spreads easily through contaminated food and surfaces, poses a risk in crowded settings like schools and travel groups. HFMD primarily affects children under 5, though most cases are mild. The CDC emphasized four key preventive measures: rigorous hand hygiene, safe food and water practices, monitoring for severe symptoms such as persistent fever, and vaccination against EV-A71 to reduce HFMD severity. Authorities continue to monitor the situation closely, with no major outbreaks reported.
news.content_zh: 2026年7月23日,黑龙江省疾控中心主任包明甲召开新闻发布会,确认夏季诺如病毒和手足口病疫情防控形势稳定。诺如病毒很容易通过受污染的食物和表面传播,在学校和旅行团等拥挤的环境中构成风险。手足口病主要影响 5 岁以下儿童,但大多数病例症状较轻。CDC 强调了四项关键的预防措施:严格的手部卫生、安全的食物和饮水习惯、监测持续发烧等严重症状,以及针对 EV-A71 的 疫苗接种 以降低手足口病的严重程度。当局继续密切关注事态发展,目前尚未收到重大 暴发 报告。

黑龙江网讯(记者贾博)“黑龙江省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病防控形势如何,疾控部门对公众特别是对家长朋友们有哪些健康提醒?”7月22日,在黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室召开“夏季重点传染病预防与公共卫生安全科普”专题新闻发布会上,省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家进行了详细解答。图片来源:黑龙江日报 纪勇 包名家介绍,进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。诺如病毒在外环境存活时间较长,不同年龄段的人群都普遍易感,多通过被病毒污染的食物、手、公共物品传播,学校、聚餐场所,特别是旅行团极易发生聚集性病例。手足口病在我省夏季为高发季节,5岁以下幼儿为高发人群,但多数为轻症,规范居家护理可痊愈。 为守护好儿童暑期身心健康,特此向广大家长朋友和孩子们提出四点核心健康提醒: 一是要做好手卫生。开展朋友们督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 二是要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 三是要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 四是要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所有要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。 包名家表示,整体来看,我省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病的防控形势总体平稳,全省疾控部门将持续做好疫情监测,落实好各项防护措施;在这里也希望广大的家长朋友们督促孩子做好日常防护,让我们共同努力,确保孩子们度过一个快乐安全的假期。 特别声明:以上内容(如有图片或视频亦包括在内)为自媒体平台“网易号”用户上传并发布,本平台仅提供信息存储服务。 Notice: The content above 黑龙江网讯(记者贾博)“黑龙江省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病防控形势如何,疾控部门对公众特别是对家长朋友们有哪些健康提醒?”7月22日,在黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室召开“夏季重点传染病预防与公共卫生安全科普”专题新闻发布会上,省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家进行了详细解答。图片来源:黑龙江日报 纪勇 包名家介绍,进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。诺如病毒在外环境存活时间较长,不同年龄段的人群都普遍易感,多通过被病毒污染的食物、手、公共物品传播,学校、聚餐场所,特别是旅行团极易发生聚集性病例。手足口病在我省夏季为高发季节,5岁以下幼儿为高发人群,但多数为轻症,规范居家护理可痊愈。 为守护好儿童暑期身心健康,特此向广大家长朋友和孩子们提出四点核心健康提醒: 一是要做好手卫生。开展朋友们督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 二是要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 三是要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 四是要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所有要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。 包名家表示,整体来看,我省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病的防控形势总体平稳,全省疾控部门将持续做好疫情监测,落实好各项防护措施;在这里也希望广大的家长朋友们督促孩子做好日常防护,让我们共同努力,确保孩子们度过一个快乐安全的假期。 特别声明:以上内容(如有图片或视频亦包括在内)为自媒体平台“网易号”用户上传并发布,本平台仅提供信息存储服务。 Notice: The content above analysis.time: Published on 2026-07-23, with the event occurring on 2026-07-22 during a provincial press conference.
analysis.location_and_population: Heilongjiang Province, China, with a focus on children and parents as the affected population.
analysis.event: The Heilongjiang Provincial Disease Control Center issued summer disease prevention guidance, specifically addressing norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) as key concerns during the summer season.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: No specific case numbers or death counts were reported. The article emphasizes that HFMD is highly prevalent in summer among children under 5, with most cases being mild. Norovirus is noted to spread easily in crowded settings like schools and travel groups.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The provincial CDC is actively monitoring the situation and implementing preventive measures. The public is advised on hygiene practices, food safety, vaccination (EV-A71 vaccine for HFMD), and respiratory disease prevention. The source is a full original report from a reputable media outlet.

analysis.brief_en: On July 22, 2026, the Heilongjiang Provincial Disease Control Center held a press conference to address summer infectious disease prevention, focusing on norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD). The center highlighted that high temperatures and humidity in summer facilitate the spread of these enteric infections, with norovirus affecting all age groups and HFMD being particularly prevalent among children under 5. Most HFMD cases are mild and can be managed at home with proper care. The public was advised on hand hygiene, food safety, proper disinfection, and vaccination to reduce risks. The CDC emphasized ongoing surveillance and urged parents to ensure children follow preventive measures to maintain a safe and healthy summer.

Most HFMD cases are mild and can be managed at home with proper care. The public was advised on hand hygiene, food safety, proper disinfection, and vaccination to reduce risks. The CDC emphasized ongoing surveillance and urged parents to ensure children follow preventive measures to maintain a safe and healthy summer.

news.content: 顶部 首页 首页 雾 / 27° 隐私 如何预防诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病?这四点健康提示请记牢 央广网 央广网哈尔滨7月23日消息(记者马俊玮)进入夏季,气温高、湿度大,极易导致诺如病毒、手足口病等肠道传染病传播。对此,黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家向广大家长朋友和孩子们提出四点核心健康提醒。 黑龙江省疾病预防控制中心主任包名家介绍相关情况(央广网发 纪勇 摄) 一是要做好手卫生。家长督促孩子饭前便后、外出回家、玩耍后要用流动水配合洗手液洗手,洗手时长不少于20秒。杜绝徒手抓食冷饮、散装零食。衣物被褥要经常晾晒,对玩具、桌椅等高频接触物品要定期使用含氯消毒剂擦拭消毒。 二是要注意饮食饮水安全。不饮用生水、尽量少吃凉拌菜,生食蔬菜水果时要彻底清洗干净。处理食材时刀具和案板要生熟分开,避免交叉污染;如果孩子被诊断为诺如病毒感染,需规范处置呕吐物,全程居家隔离,不参与校园及集体活动。 三是要密切关注患儿病情变化,重症患者要及时救治。要每日观察患儿身体状态,如果出现持续高热、精神萎靡、频繁呕吐等症状需立即就医。建议适龄儿童尽早接种EV-A71疫苗,降低手足口病重症风险。 四是要有效预防呼吸道传染病。居室要保持空气新鲜,做到经常开窗通风,每日通风2-3次、每次30分钟以上,前往密集场所要科学佩戴口罩。孩子出现不适症状及时就医、避免聚集。 包名家介绍,整体来看,黑龙江省今年夏季诺如病毒、手足口病等重点传染病的防控形势总体平稳,全省疾控部门将持续做好疫情监测,落实好各项防护措施。 评论 全部 还没有人评论过,快来抢首评 抢首评 推荐阅读 穷姑娘面试模特,一进房间傻眼,考核方式不堪入目! 挑吃兔 2026.7.07 962.2万+ 事关孩子健康与安全,家长必看!特别是在夏天→ 大西北消息... 前天09:06 3 7.10日:德不配位必有灾殃!央视表态仅6天,韩红再迎噩耗,孙浩曝内幕 旅卉聊历史 2026.7.09 268.1万+ 法院终于出手!周深案判了,结果大快人心,原来韩红当初没说谎 叮当猫娱乐 2026.7.09 42.0万+ 拒绝无效消毒,手足口专属居家消毒攻略 中部城市生... 前天10:01 85 夏季出行做好防护 警惕手足口病重症信号 中华医学网 3天前 160 长不长寿,先看体重?上了70岁,多少体重最好?医生告诉你答案 草民插头 2026.7.16 1.7万 终于不再隐瞒!张柏芝小儿子身份曝光,和谢贤的绯闻早已真相大白 星娱记 3天前 181.3万+ 黑龙江省疾控中心详解诺如、手足口病防控要点 金台资讯 前天08:27 19 匿名举报、学生骤降,大学爱情课的五年 极昼 2026.7.08 162.1万+ 二百名医生已证实:肥肉、猪油与糖尿病的真相,最好花点时间看下 朝元的小世... 2026.7.13 1.2万 家里干干净净,宝宝却中招伤寒?真凶可能就藏在厨房水槽边! 两广大地那... 4天前 36 女儿13岁了,免费HPV疫苗打不打?咱来唠唠心里话 江南水乡生... 2026.7.13 4511 小米粥被发现!医生研究发现:喝得越多,脑梗患者血管或越干净? analysis.time: Published on July 23, 2026. Event context: Summer season with high temperatures and humidity.
analysis.location_and_population: Heilongjiang Province, China. Target population: Parents and children.
analysis.event: Prevention guidance for enterovirus infections (including norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease) issued by Bao Mingjia, Director of Heilongjiang Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: No specific case numbers reported. Emphasis on prevention measures to reduce transmission risk during summer months.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Public health recommendations provided, including vaccination advice for EV-A71 to reduce severe hand-foot-mouth disease risk. Disease control situation described as 'generally stable' with ongoing monitoring and prevention measures.

analysis.brief_en: Heilongjiang Province has issued four key health recommendations to prevent enterovirus infections like norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease during the summer season. Director Bao Mingjia from the provincial CDC emphasizes hand hygiene, food and water safety, monitoring of patient symptoms, and respiratory disease prevention. Specific measures include proper handwashing, thorough cleaning of fruits and vegetables, separating raw and cooked food, and regular ventilation. The CDC notes that while the overall situation remains stable, continued vigilance is needed. Parents are advised to seek immediate medical attention for children with persistent high fever, lethargy, or frequent vomiting.

Specific measures include proper handwashing, thorough cleaning of fruits and vegetables, separating raw and cooked food, and regular ventilation. The CDC notes that while the overall situation remains stable, continued vigilance is needed.
